senses.gloss: वृद्ध- + नाभि वृद्ध- + नाभि, adj. corpulent.

वृद्ध- + प्रपितामह वृद्ध- + प्रपितामह,
 I. m. a paternal great-greatgrandfather.
 II. f. ही, a paternal great-great-grandmother.

वृद्ध- + प्रमातामह वृद्ध- + प्रमातामह,
 I. m. a maternal great-great-grandfather.
 II. f. ही, a maternal great-great-grandmother.
वृद्ध- + भाव वृद्ध- + भाव, m. old age, Pañc. 50, 8.

वृद्ध वृद्ध,
 I. ptcple. of the pr. pass. of वृध्.
 1. Old, ancient, aged, Vikr. d. 43. Comparat. ज्यायंस्, and वर्षीयंस्; superl. ज्येष्ठ, and वर्षिष्ठो, see s. v.
 2. Wise, learned.
 II. m.
 1. An old man.
 2. A sage, a respectable man, Daśak. in Chr. 201, 7.
 III. n. Benzoin.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. वृध्.
वृद्धत्व वृद्ध + त्व, m. Old age, Pañc. 226, 2.

वृद्धि वृद्धि, i. e. वृध् + ति, f.
 1. Increase, Pañc. 187, 7; augmentation, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 438.
 2. Prosperity, Bhartṛ. 2, 82; Pañc. i. d. 382.
 3. Wealth.
 4. Interest, Man. 8, 143; Pañc. 88, 14 (द्वि-गुण-, Consisting in doubling the lent amount); usury.
 5. Profit, gain, Man. 8, 401.
 6. Extension of power or revenue, Pañc. i. d. 264.
 7. A heap, a quantity, a multitude.
 8. Rise, ascending.
 9. The increase of the digits of the sun or moon.
 10. The eleventh of the astronomical योगस्, or the principal star of the eleventh lunar mansion.
 11. Cutting off.
 12. (In law), Forfeiture.
 --Comp.

वृद्धिमन्त् वृद्धि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती,
 1. Augmented, increased, increasing, Pañc. ii. d. 38; Bhartṛ. 2, 50.
 2. Wealthy.
 3. Prosperous.
वृद्ध- + श्रवस् वृद्ध- + श्रवस् (vb. वृध्), m. Indra.
वृद्धि- + श्राद्ध वृद्धि- + श्राद्ध, n. a sacrifice to progenitors on any prosperous occasion, as a birth of a son, etc.
